data.value: Does Dr. Emily Zhao detect the anomalous signal from the radio telescope before the observation window closes on October 1, 2026?

The Arecibo Observatory's radio telescope is operational and collecting data. The observation window for the current SETI project closes on October 1, 2026. An anomalous signal may or may not be present in the data.
